features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, -2 Charisma.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium creature; no inherent size bonuses or penalties.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with galka subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 20 ft. land speed; not slowed by armor or encumbrance.

effects.textValue: Do not reduce land speed for armor or encumbrance.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts Common and Galkan, can select Dwarven, Elvaan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan or Orc with sufficient Intelligence.

features.name: Hardy
features.description: +2 racial saves versus poison, spells, spell-like abilities.

condition.description: Saving throw is versus poison, spell, or spell-like ability.

features.name: Stability
features.description: +4 racial CMD resisting bull rush and trip while standing on ground.

condition.description: Bull rush or trip while standing on ground.

features.name: Imposing Figure
features.description: +2 racial Intimidate.

features.name: Mining Servitude
features.description: +2 racial Profession (miner).

features.name: Metalworker
features.description: +2 racial Appraise and Craft checks related to metal.

features.name: Ferocity
features.description: Once per day when reduced below zero HP but not killed, function as disabled for one round. At end of next turn fall unconscious and begin dying unless brought above zero HP.

actions.name: Ferocity
actions.trigger: Below 0 hit points but not dead
actions.notes: May act as disabled for one round; unconscious and dying at end of next turn if still below zero.

features.name: Hatred
features.description: +1 racial attack against Antica or Hume.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: +2 CMB bull rush/overrun while both creatures are standing on ground.

condition.description: Both Galka and opponent stand on ground.

features.name: Weapon Familiarity
features.description: Proficient with war pick and Galkan racial weapons.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far as a hume in dim light.

effects.textValue: Twice normal viewing distance in dim conditions.

features.name: Architectural Ingenuity
features.description: +2 racial Knowledge (engineering), Craft and Perception checks relating to structures, including structural traps.

features.name: Beastmaster
features.description: Whips and nets treated as martial weapons; +2 racial Handle Animal checks.

features.name: Cavewight
features.description: +1 racial Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival while underground.

features.name: Chain Fighter
features.description: Proficient with flails and heavy flails; dire flails and spiked chains count as martial weapons.

features.name: City-Raised
features.description: Proficient whips and longswords, +2 racial Knowledge (local).

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Gain darkvision 60 ft. instead of low-light vision, and lose Metalworker.

features.name: Scavenger
features.description: +2 racial Appraise; +2 Perception finding hidden objects (traps/secret doors), judging spoiled food, or identifying potions by taste.

features.name: Stoic
features.description: Normally forgo morale bonuses; +2 racial saves versus fear/emotion and +2 DC to intimidate. Can opt to gain morale bonus and lose this trait for 24 hours.

actions.name: Temporarily waive Stoic
actions.trigger: Choose to accept a morale bonus
actions.notes: Disables benefits of Stoic for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Tenacious
features.description: Once per day after failing a Fortitude save, Will save, or Constitution check, reroll and keep second result.

actions.name: Tenacious reroll
actions.trigger: Failed Fortitude save, Will save or Constitution check
actions.notes: Reroll once, use second result even if worse.

features.name: Wary
features.description: +1 racial Sense Motive and Bluff.

features.name: Reincarnation
features.description: Galka are reincarnated after death, typically after one month to one year. New bodies have hazy past-life memories but no prior traits/abilities; once reincarnation occurs, the original body cannot be raised from the dead.
